lines.text: Many learners say: What is your good name?
Just say name. Good name sounds strange.

data.why: Just say name. Good name sounds strange.

native.tip: हिंदी में “आपका शुभ नाम” चलता है, पर अंग्रेज़ी में बस “What is your name?” बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप “What is your good name?” पूछते हैं? 🙈 अंग्रेज़ी में “good” नहीं लगता — सीधे “What is your name?” पूछिए। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “name”। “good name” हटा दें और सीधे पूछें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: In Hindi a polite “good name” works, but in English just say “What is your name?”
en.caption: Do you ask “What is your good name?” 🙈 English does not need “good” here — just ask “What is your name?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
